title: Bakemonogatari
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Koyomi Araragi, a high schooler who survived a vampire attack, helps girls afflicted by 'oddities', supernatural phenomena that stand in for their emotional wounds, such as Hitagi Senjogahara, whose weight was taken by a crab god. Oh! great's manga adapts Nisio Isin's light novels with heavy wordplay and stylized art. It is known for strong fan service.
life_message: It holds up facing your own hidden wounds, since, as the story puts it, people must ultimately save themselves.
